snippet.title: Double Trip - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Double Trip is out now on Steam and Itch.io! Playable on Windows, Linux and macOS.
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3414480/Double_Trip/
Itch.io page: https://maxyland.itch.io/double-trip

Double Trip is a tile-based sokoban game about solving puzzles with the help of two friendly characters. Travel through a beautiful island by learning how its different elements interact with each other.

Traverse an overworld through branching paths and enjoy the beautiful and vibrant artstyle while listening to a relaxing original soundtrack.

Push rocks into holes and connect islands with logs in various well-designed levels suited for all kinds of players.
- Challenge yourself with more complicated optional stages. 
- Enjoy the singleplayer experience or share problem-solving moments with your friends through local 2 player co-op mode.
- Express yourself with fully customizable characters!
- Discover deep mechanics within simple objects.

And the most important thing... Solve, explore, and just have fun!


Development, programming and art by @MaxyLAND.
Music, sound and level design by @javago-o.

Special thanks to @DavJT for the promotional art and various ideas for the trailer ;)
